resources.string: Corrections, phrases, own words, abbreviations, other languages
What the keyboard keeps from your typing, only on this device. The lists are only here.

Typos you fixed later in a field, also after more words or after going back into the word. Only when a non-word became a real word by a slip of a finger (a neighbouring key, a missing, doubled or swapped letter, an umlaut). Changing a real word into another one is never learned. Needs \"Learn my typos\".
Seen once. Learned when you fix the same typo again in another place, or when you adopt it here.

Local, only on this device. Learns word sequences from your own sentences, slang you keep and abbreviations you expand by hand. Nothing in password fields, incognito, fields without learning, excluded apps, with learning paused or on a locked device. It never changes your text: a tap on a chip only adds the rest after the cursor.
Local similarity of words and word parts, no download. A tap inserts the snippet at the cursor.
No phrases yet. Sequences of three or more words appear here once you typed them a few times.
Words you committed three times as typed although the keyboard did not know them, or after undoing their correction. They are not corrected any more and are offered while you type their start.

When you replace a short form by its expansion twice yourself, the strip offers once to remember it. Afterwards the strip suggests the expansion after the short form; only your tap replaces the short form. Nothing is written to the personal dictionary.
Nothing is learned or offered in these apps.
Forget all phrases, own words and abbreviations? Excluded apps stay.
Unlock the device to see the memory.
Remember the abbreviation %1$s for %2$s: then suggested after %1$s, never applied by itself

Words of another of your languages that you kept while writing in this one: after you undid their correction once, or wrote them twice in other places. They are no longer corrected away in that language and are suggested while you type their start. Needs \"Personalized suggestions\".
